title: CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes formats the raw serde_json error with `{error}` into an INPUT_INVALID detail
description: CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes formats the raw serde_json error with `{error}` into an INPUT_INVALID detail. Serde Data errors can echo input values (for example `invalid type: string "..."`, `unknown field `x``). The doc promises 'never a payload byte outside a question id'. The sibling code in jev/v1.rs avoids this with `describe` and `JevError::encode_failed` (category and position only). The two code paths are inconsistent, and the doc claim does not hold.
